metaDescription: Order custom heavyweight golf polo shirts for your team. Durable fabric, bulk pricing. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Heavyweight golf polo shirts offer a structured, durable feel that lighter polos can't match. Ideal for corporate golf outings or year-round uniform wear, these polos resist wrinkling and hold their shape after repeated washes. Choose 8-ounce pique cotton or poly-cotton blends for a professional look that stands up to active use. Add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, lasting finish.
heroAltText: Custom heavyweight golf polo shirts with embroidery on the chest, displayed in corporate team colors.
